questions.question: You are at a restaurant with a friend. Your friend accidentally spills coffee on your jacket. Which response is the most appropriate?
options: That's terrible. I'll wash it myself.
Oh no! That's a shame. Let me get you some tissues and help clean it up.
It's fine, it happens all the time.
I told you not to drink so quickly.
questions.answer: Oh no! That's a shame. Let me get you some tissues and help clean it up.

questions.question: A colleague asks, "Could you possibly spare a few minutes to help me with this report?" Which response is the most polite and professional?
options: Sure, I can do that.
No, I'm too busy right now.
Why do you need help with that?
I don't think I have time for that.

questions.question: During a group discussion, someone says, "I think we should start the project next week." Which response best expresses disagreement while remaining polite?
options: That's a bad idea.
I'm not sure if next week is the best time to start.
Agreed, let's do it then.
I completely agree with you.
questions.answer: I'm not sure if next week is the best time to start.

questions.question: You are talking to a stranger in a queue at the post office. Someone bumps into you. Which response is the most suitable for this context?
options: Watch where you're going!
Sorry about that, I didn't see you.
You're clumsy.
I'm going to sue you.
questions.answer: Sorry about that, I didn't see you.

questions.question: A friend calls you late at night saying they are feeling very unwell. Which response shows empathy and offers appropriate support?
options: Oh no! Are you sure you need to call? Maybe just take some medicine.
That's weird. Why didn't you say earlier?
I'm busy. Call me back tomorrow.
Don't worry about it, it will pass.
questions.answer: Oh no! Are you sure you need to call? Maybe just take some medicine.
